concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑004 (generate a substantial set of ≥ 1 000 unique stories from the brain‑inspired model) has no corresponding task. The current tasks only generate hidden‑state representations for the held‑out fMRI story set (≈ 100 stories) and never create a large corpus of novel stories.
Success Criterion SC‑005 (≥ 1 000 unique generated stories) is not covered by any task. T046 references SC‑005 but no earlier task produces or validates the required number of stories.
